title: H2 typed bin records, two persistent render engines, shared CUs and exact prefix restart
scope: Uncommitted optional hardware integration; no production host command ABI or full-frame qualification.
current_stage_ppa_policy: Synthesis-only screening, selected by the user on 2026-10-18; new routing runs deferred.

abi.addressing: firstHandle+n -> records.base+64*n; primitive consumes two consecutive handles.
abi.fields: Full 32-bit clip XYZW, RGBA alpha, depth, Q16.16 UV, scissor and immutable per-draw state/texture binding.
abi.validation: Reject unknown versions, reserved words/bits and unsupported state; preflight the complete primitive span before reads.

admission.grid: Disjoint row-major 8x8/16x16 tiles with partial edges; check every tile before memory traffic.
admission.ownership: Snapshot context/pass/generation; disjoint bin/record/image arenas; retain ownership through completion.
admission.shader: Disjoint per-engine windows; relative staging offsets, aligned strides and full bank spans checked before relocation.

shared_system_tests.memory: Translated bin/image/texture line client and separate translated per-engine staging clients.

coverage: Ordered independent-image comparison for depth/stencil, blending, partial tiles, 4x MSAA/resolve and untouched guard pixels.
More than eight references per tile across linked bin pages.
Independent engine progress with held attachment acknowledgements and tile completions.
Malformed draw records, multi-line read faults, attachment load/store faults, texture/shader faults, offered-request cancellation and healthy reuse.
Real fragment instructions on system CUs in bare and Sv32 modes, fresh address-space generations/backings, staging-span rejection and invalid bin mapping.
Bounded per-client shared task windows, duplicate local tag exclusion, reordered faults/completions and stable launches/invalidation owners under backpressure.
Exact UNORM8 RGBA texture modulation; exhaustive 65536-pair product oracle and white/colored/nonopaque texture image checks.
Exact exhaustion restart tags for empty and nonempty prefixes; load-and-resume image matches uninterrupted ordering; discard and export-fault suppression.
Existing shared-system two/four-CU profiles through 16 lanes/eight warps, bounded compute-memory stall with simultaneous graphics progress and fault recovery.

restart.policy: Caller-driven continuation after draining the whole binding; require final pass success/exhaustion, both attachment planes stored, then load saved attachments and submit the first rejected reference exactly once.

replay_request.result: Three-engine rotation reproduced a stalled memory offer changing transaction ID from 2 to 0.
replay_request.fix: Two-entry request queue freezes arbitration result and retains reader response ownership through cancellation/drain.

invalidation.result: With a known arbitration rotation, a new client replaces a stalled invalidation address 0x8000 with 0x9000.
invalidation.fix: Capture invalidate request and requesting owner before offering to the pool; retain both through the untagged acknowledgement.

shared_compute_regression.initial_result: 136/137 pass; bare two-CU test saw no simultaneous compute/graphics occupancy.
shared_compute_regression.diagnosis: Trace shows compute runs in cycles 1136-1214, entirely inside the gap before the next graphics wave at 1268. Both workloads complete.
shared_compute_regression.correction: Keep simultaneous-occupancy assertion; delay the independent compute payload response by 512 cycles so the test exercises graphics progress while compute awaits memory.
